note: every entry below was a real defect in one of MY OWN instruments before it was written down. They are the cheapest thing in this package.

traps.trap: the response does NOT contain spec_hash
traps.consequence: reading it from the POST yields None for every cell, so N distinct experiments collapse to '1 distinct hash'

traps.trap: the item is NESTED under a 'work' key, not flat
traps.consequence: reading it flat scores zero claim winners and looks exactly like a broken claim path

traps.trap: forked children are created in state CREATED, not RUNNING
traps.consequence: the experiment path enforces RUNNING, so nothing enqueues and work/claim returns nothing

traps.trap: owner-scoped; a new client sees zero worlds
traps.consequence: an 'archaeologist' registered as a fresh client sees an empty store and concludes wrongly
traps.do: use the owning client's token, or read the store directly

traps.trap: verified_n COMPUTES, it does not echo declared_n
traps.measured: 10 observations from ONE world: declared_n 1/8/10/99 all return verified_n=1 and unit_mismatch flips true
traps.do: trust verified_n; treat unit_mismatch as the signal

traps.note: before 2026-09-04 URL-safe was accepted and SILENTLY TRUNCATED -- distrust artifact bytes written earlier
traps.do: verify the returned blob_hash equals sha256(your bytes)

traps.trap: blob_hash is world-INdependent; artifact_id hashes an envelope {world, kind, blob, meta}
traps.consequence: the same bytes in two worlds give DIFFERENT artifact_ids

traps.trap: a prediction registered AFTER the experiment commit is not prospective and needs retrospective:true permanently
without work_id an observation is CLIENT_ASSERTED, not ENGINE_WORK_RESULT
member_kind refuses 'family' (422), so an amendment chain is sealed text in the manifest and NOT a traversable relation
traps.do: record amends_family in the manifest and expect no engine-side traversal
